data.body: Benchmark chat.59195e920fc296dbb852c5072bf61c8b65bad3e7 (Tetris test1_small2, deepseek-flash, contextWindow 100,000 frozen, reasoningEffort medium): best run yet - 58 turns, 8.2 min, 93.30% cache, 221,595 uncached, 128,262 output, $0.2389, selfcheck 53/53.
